scope.summary: Implement the face channel set (spec 13.23; OBR decouple law applied to the face, REQ-001/002 lineage): brow, eye, nose, mouth/lips, jaw, and cheek region channels - decoupled, multi-key, same channel architecture as the body - plus the hybrid face-bones/morphs rig with a documented articulation-vs-identity split.
acceptance_criteria: Face region channels registered per MT-492 discipline: brow, eye (shape/size/tilt/spacing), nose, mouth/lips, jaw, and cheek groups, each masked to its face sub-region; BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID extends to face sub-regions.
Hybrid rig: face bones (jaw, eyes, lids per the MT-514 skeleton lineage) coexist with morph channels under a documented split - bones carry articulation, morphs carry shape/identity.
Namespace separation: identity channels (face_id_*) never collide with expression morph names, so expressions layer cleanly in later MTs.
Multi-key tracks with designed over-range support stylized/extreme face proportions without linear-extrapolation artifacts.
scope.risk_if_missed: Face identity channels that leak across regions reproduce the Daz FBM entanglement on the face; without the hybrid bones/morphs split, the ARKit baseline and arousal expression library have no stable articulation base to layer on.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
